description: Search the islands' newspapers with paper and issue-date filters, ranked by how closely each page matches. Use when a question names a paper or a period, or needs paging. Searches the OCR text of the archive's newspapers page by page: St. Croix Avis 1865–2001, St. Croix Tribune 1934–1936, Home Journal 1952–1958, The West End News 1953–1963. Every run has gaps, which list_papers names. Issue dates are reliable here. Each result is ONE PAGE with its paper, date and page number, a TIER (phrase = the words together as written, ranked first; strong = every word on the page, not together; possible = at least half; weak = fewer), the terms it actually matched, and links to the page in the site's reader, the holding library's copy, and its image where the archive holds one. No numeric score. A date range that falls in a gap — whole years, or weeks inside a year — gets a sentence naming the dates the archive does not hold. Results are OCR text, which misreads letters, names and numbers; each links the holding library's copy to check against, and the page image where the archive holds one (for the 1964–2001 dLOC run, front pages only). A newspaper page is a lead to the primary record, not evidence on its own. Hit counts are pages, never articles. Laws, audits, court records and reports are on the archive's separate document connector.

date_from.description: Earliest issue date: a year (1928), a month (1928-09) or a day (1928-09-13).

date_to.description: Latest issue date, same forms; a year includes all of it.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Results are ranked within the best 150 pages.

paper.description: A paper: "St. Croix Avis", "The West End News", "Home Journal", "St. Croix Tribune" (or avis, westendnews, homejournal, tribune).

query.description: Plain language is fine. Quote a phrase to require it intact. OCR misspells names: try variants.

name: search_newspapers
title: Search newspapers with filters
